published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead (follows its base build, warlock__destruction_fire); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 972.5 as Human on the same sim)

summary: Keeps Curse of the Elements on the boss for the raid. In Forever, curses and banes use separate slots, so it keeps its bane.
rotation: Racials on cooldown, except Troll Berserking
Life Tap below 5% mana or when Incinerate costs more than the mana left
Curse of the Elements right after the opener, recast before it drops
Bane of Doom with more than 60s left, so it lands before the end
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down or has under 1.5s left, with more than 15s left
Immolate when it is down or has under 1.5s left, with more than 4s left
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
Troll Berserking right before an Incinerate or Shadow Bolt, so the haste goes on cast spells, not instants
caveats: The duty curse costs only GCDs and mana, because banes and curses use separate slots.
Firestone is 9.7 ahead of Spellstone. The best build with the Succubus out is 5.1 behind. Sacrificing the Imp is 69 behind, and the Felhunter 101.
Unverified: whether Incinerate's 25% bonus applies to the whole hit. Bane of Havoc's point does nothing.
How much of the warlock's stats a demon gets, and Succubus melee, come from pet sheets at levels 20 and 30, not 60.
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era has 1.0). At 2.0, Shadow Bolt builds would lose about 4%. At 1.0, about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI). They would add 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is active. The 5-piece added about 8 to 13 DPS on an older gear set.
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
Demons use the warlock's spell crit, a reported Forever bug. It's worth 15 to 17 DPS.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warlock__destruction_fire except -apl level60_destruction_fire_duty_curse, then raid.debuffs.curseOfElements set to false.
